purpose: Attributed reviewer decisions become labeled data: the seed of the self-learning loop (recalibration brief Tier 2 item 7) and the labeled baseline any future model (CV damage localization, triage) must beat before adoption.
rules: Rows are built only from terminal reviewed sessions with an attributed human decision.
One row per session; rows are immutable once appended.
Compensation or incentive language is structurally refused in all text fields.
Slot labels bind the reviewer disposition to artifact digests and the quality-gate verdict that admitted them.
Exporting real-tenant data for training is counsel-gated; this contract only defines row shape and validation.
